name: ADX trend strength
description: Only trade when a real trend is present, in the direction ADX's DI lines point.

about.how_it_works: ADX measures how strong a trend is, regardless of direction; above 25 usually means trending. When +DI crosses above -DI during a strong trend, buyers have taken control. A trailing stop follows the move up.
about.works_best: Filtering out sideways markets that break simpler trend strategies.
about.fails_when: ADX lags: by the time it confirms a trend, part of the move is gone, and it can stay high as a trend ends.
